title: ProjectE rail -> connector contact-group map
description: Input to tools/scripts/connector_current.py. Which rail passes through which contact group of which connector is a PROJECT fact and belongs in system-planning/, never inside the checker. This file also carries the provenance that neither of the two artefacts it binds can hold: rail-tree/v1 pins exactly seven fields per rail and forbids others, so there is nowhere in it to say where i_max_a came from; connector-spec/v1 has a per-CONTACT current object and no field for a per-GROUP rating.

links.$comment: May be empty only if every rail appears in excluded_rails; the checker reports an unaccounted rail as MAPPING_INCOMPLETE -> NO_COVERAGE.

excluded_rails.$comment: Rails that cross no connector. Declared rather than inferred: scanned + excluded == eligible is the coverage rule, and a rail that is silently neither is a rail nobody checked.

rail.$comment: Key into rail_tree.rails. A name the rail tree does not contain is RAIL_NOT_IN_RAIL_TREE, never a quiet skip.

contacts.$comment: The contacts that carry this rail. Never defaulted to one: the group size is exactly the question a capacity figure has to have been read for.

return_contacts.$comment: Informational here. konnektor SKILL 3b: the GND return must be carried by the same number of contacts; this checker does not enforce that and says so in its limits.

policy.$comment: There is no third option and no default. 'n_times_rated' and its spellings do not load: the centre contact runs hottest, its resistance rises and it sheds current to the outer ones, so N contacts do not carry N times one contact's current.

group_rated_a.$comment: Required by sourced_group_rating. READ off the derating curve for THIS grouping at the ambient the thermal report predicts - not computed from the per-contact figure.

capacity.$comment: single_contact takes its number from connector_spec.current.derated_a_per_contact, so its source is connector_spec.datasheet_locator plus derating_basis/ambient_c. sourced_group_rating states the number here, so it states its source here too.

demand.$comment: The VALUE is read from rail_tree.rails[].i_max_a, never from here. Only the provenance lives here, because rail-tree/v1 has no field for it.

reason.$comment: An exclusion without a stated reason is how a rail leaves the numerator and the denominator at the same time.

revision.$comment: A document without a revision names a FAMILY of documents; the one that was read is not recoverable later. Same rule as common/vendormodel.py PROVENANCE_FIELDS.

locator.$comment: Which table, figure, page or field. 'the datasheet' does not answer 'which curve, at which ambient'.
